series.name: UAE split generic — AirChill troubleshooting guide
series.notes: Super General UAE split table from AirChill AC Maintenance (Dubai) technician guide. Cross-source conflicts on E1/E3/E4/E5 noted per-code. No official SG table; no LED blink maps found.

title.ur: EEPROM / aam general self-diagnostic ki kharabi

meaning.en: Shown during power-up self-check; typically means an EEPROM memory fault or an unspecific general system malfunction.
meaning.ur: Power up hone ke waqt self-check ke dauran aata hai; aam tor par iska matlab EEPROM memory ki kharabi ya system ki koi aam be-tay kharabi hoti hai.

causes.en: Control-board EEPROM data corrupted or lost
causes.ur: Control board ka EEPROM data kharab ya kho gaya

causes.en: Power surge / supply disturbance during startup
causes.ur: Startup ke dauran power surge ya supply ki gadbad

solutions.en: Power off, wait five minutes, then restart once
solutions.ur: Power band karein, 5 minute intezar karein, phir ek baar start karein

solutions.en: If it returns, have a technician inspect or replace the indoor/outdoor control board
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to technician se indoor/outdoor control board ka check karwayein ya use badalwayein

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Meaning per single Dubai technician page; Voltiat Arabic mirror repeats it. Accio does not list E0. Model scope unstated; treat as generic SG split. Fixya user also reported E0 on SG inverter (answers there were off-brand).
notes.ur: Matlab sirf ek Dubai technician page se hai; Voltiat Arabic mirror yehi dohrata hai. Accio mein E0 nahi hai. Model ka scope nahi likha; generic SG split maan lein. Fixya par ek user ne SG inverter par E0 bataya (wahan ke jawab brand ke bahar ke the).

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units are not exchanging signals correctly, so the system cannot run normally.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit aapas mein signal theek tarah nahi bhej pa rahe, is liye system aam tor par chalta nahi.

causes.en: Loose, wrong, or damaged inter-unit wiring
causes.ur: Dono unit ke darmiyan wiring dheeli, galat ya kharab

causes.en: Faulty indoor or outdoor control board, or electrical interference on the signal line
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor control board kharab, ya signal line par electrical interference

solutions.en: Power-cycle the unit once and recheck cable terminals
solutions.ur: Unit ka ek baar power cycle karein aur cable ke terminals dobara check karein

solutions.en: If the code persists, call a technician to test the signal wire and PCBs
solutions.ur: Agar code qaim rahe to technician ko bulayein jo signal wire aur PCB test kare

source.title: Accio — Super General AC Error Code List 2026 (FAQ)

notes.en: Only Accio states E1 (AirChill's main list omits E1). Conflicts with Persian-labelled SG table where E1 = evaporator sensor — see §5.4.
notes.ur: E1 sirf Accio batata hai (AirChill ki main list E1 ko nahi leti). Persian-labelled SG table se conflict hai jahan E1 = evaporator sensor — dekhein §5.4.

meaning.en: On this inverter split model, E3 was identified as a communication failure between indoor and outdoor units.
meaning.ur: Is inverter split model par E3 ko indoor aur outdoor units ke darmiyan communication failure bataya gaya hai.

causes.en: Wiring issue between units
causes.ur: Do units ke darmiyan wiring ka masla

causes.en: Defective control board in either unit
causes.ur: Kisi ek unit mein control board kharab hona

solutions.en: Switch off the supply for a few minutes and restart
solutions.ur: Pehle supply band kar ke chand minute rukein, phir dobara start karein

solutions.en: If it stays, book professional diagnosis
solutions.ur: Agar code hat nahi to professional se diagnosis karwayein

source.title: Fixya — 'Sorry my ac show me error code e3 type super general model sgsi188-i5'

notes.en: Single Fixya 'expert' answer; model-scoped (SGSi188-i5). E3 meaning varies widely across brands — do not generalise. Persian table says E3 = evaporator coil sensor (conflict).
notes.ur: Sirf ek Fixya 'expert' jawab hai; model-specific (SGSi188-i5). E3 ka matlab brands mein kaafi alag hai — aam taur par lagu na karein. Persian table kehti hai E3 = evaporator coil sensor (conflict).

title.en: Indoor fan motor fault or frost protection
title.ur: Indoor fan motor kharabi ya frost protection

meaning.en: Either the indoor fan motor is misbehaving, or the unit has entered anti-frost (freeze-up) protection.
meaning.ur: Ya to indoor fan motor theek kaam nahi kar raha, ya unit anti-frost (jaldi barf) protection mein chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Clogged filters or blocked indoor airflow causing coil freeze
causes.ur: Filters gande ya indoor airflow band hone se coil par jaldi barf ban gayi

causes.en: Indoor fan motor failure or wiring fault
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor kharab ya wiring mein kharabi

solutions.en: Clean or replace air filters and let any ice melt
solutions.ur: Air filters saaf karein ya badal dein aur jo barf bani ho use pighalne dein

solutions.en: If the fault remains, technician checks the fan motor
solutions.ur: Agar kharabi qaim rahe to technician fan motor check kare

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Dual meaning (fan vs frost) per source. Persian-labelled table: E4 = indoor DC fan motor only — roughly compatible. Accio omits E4.
notes.ur: Source ke mutabiq do matlab hain (fan ya frost). Persian-labelled table: E4 = sirf indoor DC fan motor — taqreeban mutabiq. Accio E4 nahi batata.

meaning.en: The unit locked out because the compressor drew excessive current or was overloaded.
meaning.ur: Unit lock ho gaya kyunke compressor ne zyad current kheechi ya us par overload aa gaya.

causes.en: Dirty outdoor unit or blocked condenser airflow raising head pressure
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ganda ya condenser ka airflow band, jis se head pressure barh gaya

causes.en: Weak supply voltage, failing capacitor, or failing compressor
causes.ur: Supply voltage kamzor, capacitor kharab, ya compressor kharab

solutions.en: Clean the outdoor unit and remove anything blocking airflow
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit saaf karein aur hawa ko rokne wali cheez hata dein

solutions.en: Have a technician test capacitor, amperage, and compressor
solutions.ur: Technician se capacitor, ampere aur compressor test karwayein

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Voltiat (Arabic) mirrors this meaning. Persian table: E5 = 'needs specialist / blower-board comm issue' (conflict, low trust).
notes.ur: Voltiat (Arabic) yehi matlab dohrata hai. Persian table: E5 = 'expert chahiye / blower-board comm ka masla' (conflict, bharosa kam).

meaning.en: Communication between indoor and outdoor units has broken down, stopping normal operation.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units ka communication toot gaya hai, jis se normal kaam ruk gaya hai.

causes.en: Loose or damaged inter-unit wiring / poor connections
causes.ur: Dono unit ke darmiyan wiring dheeli ya kharab / connections zayf

causes.en: Power-surge damage, or a defective indoor/outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Power surge se nuqsan, ya indoor/outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check and secure all wiring, then reset the AC
solutions.ur: Saari wiring check kar ke mazboot karein, phir AC reset karein

solutions.en: If the code returns, PCB replacement may be needed
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to PCB badalna par sakta hai

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Agreed by Accio FAQ (E6 = communication malfunction) and Voltiat — 3 pages, same meaning → high. Not to be confused with Gree-style E6 (indoor fan).
notes.ur: Accio FAQ (E6 = communication malfunction) aur Voltiat dono sehmat hain — 3 pages, ek hi matlab → high. Gree wale E6 (indoor fan) ke sath na milayein.

title.en: Drainage / water pump or water-level fault
title.ur: Drainage / paani ka pump ya paani ki level ki kharabi

meaning.en: Indoor-unit drainage problem: blocked drain, failed pump, or a water-level alarm (also summarized as a water drainage issue).
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka drainage masla: drain band, pump kharab, ya paani ki level ka alarm (jise paani na nikalne ki masla bhi kaha gaya).

causes.en: Clogged drainage pipe
causes.ur: Drainage pipe gandi hui

causes.en: Water pump failure
causes.ur: Paani ka pump kharab

causes.en: Blocked filters or indoor coil contributing to overflow
causes.ur: Gande filters ya indoor coil ki wajah se paani barh jata hai

solutions.en: Clean the drainage pipe / drain pan
solutions.ur: Drainage pipe ya drain pan saaf karein

solutions.en: Reset the unit; if it persists, call a technician (pump check)
solutions.ur: Unit reset karein; masla qaim rahe to technician ko bulayein (pump check)

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Corroborated by Voltiat table and field YouTube Short 'Super general ac E9 error'. Two full-text sources + video title → high. Note: on many other brands E9 means something else.
notes.ur: Voltiat table aur field YouTube Short 'Super general ac E9 error' ise tasdeeq karti hain. Do poori sources + video title → high. Note: deegar brands par E9 ka matlab alag hota hai.

meaning.en: The self-diagnosis flagged a probable refrigerant leak (low gas / copper-pipe leak).
meaning.ur: Self-diagnosis ne ehtimali refrigerant leak bataya (kam gaz / copper pipe mein leak).

causes.en: Leak in copper piping or joints
causes.ur: Copper piping ya joints mein leak

causes.en: Low gas pressure; faulty pressure/sensor input giving a false trip
causes.ur: Gaz ka pressure kam; pressure/sensor ka input kharab hone se ghalat trip

solutions.en: Turn the unit off immediately to protect the compressor
solutions.ur: Compressor ki hifazat ke liye unit foran band kar dein

solutions.en: Technician must leak-test, repair, and recharge to spec
solutions.ur: Technician ko leak test, repair aur spec ke mutabiq gas charge karna hoga

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Accio FAQ also defines SG EC as refrigerant leakage detection (low pressure or pipe leak); Voltiat agrees. Accio elsewhere notes some brands use EC for communication — keep SG = leak per these sources.
notes.ur: Accio FAQ SG EC ko refrigerant leakage detection bhi batata hai (low pressure ya pipe leak); Voltiat sehamat hai. Accio ki jagah kuch brands EC communication ke liye istemal karte hain — in sources ke mutabiq SG = leak rakhein.

title.ur: Line mein low voltage ya overcurrent ki kharabi

meaning.en: Rare combined code linked to supply voltage problems (undervoltage or overcurrent conditions).
meaning.ur: Yeh combined code kam aata hai aur supply voltage ki masala se judi hai (low voltage ya overcurrent).

causes.en: Mains voltage sag or surge outside unit limits
causes.ur: Mains voltage unit ki had se gir jaye ya surge ho

causes.en: Poor grounding or damaged supply wiring
causes.ur: Zameen (earthing) kamzor ya supply wiring kharab

solutions.en: Install/use a voltage stabilizer
solutions.ur: Voltage stabilizer lagayein aur istemal karein

solutions.en: Electrician should inspect grounding and mains wiring
solutions.ur: Electrician zameen aur mains wiring ka check kare

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Exact display string as published: 'EL OC' (no space variants confirmed). Voltiat repeats. Unverified against a manual.
notes.ur: Display string bilkul waisi hi hai jaise di gayi hai: 'EL OC' (bina space wale variant ki tasdeeq nahi hui). Voltiat bhi yehi dohrata hai. Manual se tasdeeq nahi hui.

title.ur: Khatam-taarif kharabi (sirf is ka zikr hai)

meaning.en: The guide's intro claims users may see E10, but the article never defines it.
meaning.ur: Guide ke intro mein kaha gaya hai ke user E10 dekh sakte hain, lekin article ne isay kabhi define hi nahi kiya.

causes.en: A model-specific fault that the guide mentions in its intro but never explains
causes.ur: Model-specific kharabi jise guide apne intro mein zikr karti hai lekin kabhi tafseel nahi karti

causes.en: Leftover SEO or typo text in the article rather than a real displayed code
causes.ur: Article mein SEO ka bacha hua lafz ya typo, asal mein display par aane wala code nahi

solutions.en: Check the model number on the unit and look up that model's own error list or user manual, because this guide never defines E10.
solutions.ur: Unit par likha model number dekhein aur usi model ki apni error list ya user manual check karein, kyunke is guide mein E10 ka matlab kahin nahi likha.

solutions.en: If the manual has no E10 either, power-cycle the AC once and watch whether the code clears or changes.
solutions.ur: Manual mein bhi E10 na mile to AC ka ek baar power cycle karein aur dekhein ke code hat jata hai ya badalta hai.

solutions.en: Take a photo of the display and contact official support or a technician instead of guessing the meaning.
solutions.ur: Display ka photo le lein aur matlab andaze se na lagayein, official support ya technician se rabta karein.

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Intro/SEO mentions ('E9, EC, E5, or E10', 'From E9 to E10') but no E10 section exists — kept for exhaustiveness with empty causes.
notes.ur: Intro/SEO mein zikr hai ('E9, EC, E5, or E10', 'From E9 to E10') lekin E10 ka koi section hi nahi — poori list ke liye rakha hai, causes abhi khaali hain.

title.ur: Aam 'Error' ya sirf 'E' — number ke baghair

meaning.en: The panel shows only 'Error' or 'E' with no number — an unspecific general system fault.
meaning.ur: Panel sirf 'Error' ya 'E' dikhata hai, koi number nahi — yeh system ki aam be-tay kharabi hai.

causes.en: Any undiagnosed system fault the board could not name
causes.ur: Koi aisi system kharabi jise board apna naam nahi sake

causes.en: Transient glitch after a power disturbance
causes.ur: Bijli mein gadbad ke baad achanak aane wali kharabi

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and restart it
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur phir se start karein

solutions.en: Check the user manual / official site; get an inspection if it returns
solutions.ur: User manual ya official website dekhein; agar wapas aaye to inspection karwa lein

source.title: Super General AC Error Code Troubleshooting Guide (AirChill)

notes.en: Also carries the site's generic reset recipe (unplug 5 min, restart; recurring code = call tech). 'Reset' in their summary table is an action, not a fault code — not ingested as an entry.
notes.ur: Iske sath site ka generic reset tareeqa bhi hai (plug 5 minute nikaalein, phir restart; code baar baar aaye to technician bulayein). Unke summary table mein 'Reset' ek amal hai, fault code nahi — entry ke tor par dakhil nahi kiya.
